result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I’d recommend **Dropbox Sign or DocuSign**\. They both handle the core job well: sending contracts, collecting signatures, tracking progress and automatically storing completed documents.

However, if you're operating in Australia, there are a few other options worth considering, particularly Australian-based providers.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for simplicity)

- Easy to set up and use.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Automatic reminders and audit trails.
- Good Dropbox and Google Drive integration.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests according to current plan comparisons.

Indicative starting price: around US\$15/month.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall)

- Very widely recognised.
- Excellent contract templates.
- Signing workflows and automated reminders.
- Strong integrations with business software.
- Detailed audit trails.

Australian pricing starts at approximately A\$15/month for Personal, with Standard at A\$37/user/month.

[DocuSign Australia](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)

---

![Annature](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ajDlQ4iEQSWiUrNSiiYa3PBzbS3E9LMmDFEF5w0gC4YywypR_OfCZzcQHGxmJ93Bw6W3kdLOStVGOC-XwiIfrfKAb-cJF-VTKTaiR_YKNe2-JEBWth8EYs4f7BuBWLrJPCGttgYvC70mNM3hL8x1nwdBtEahr-UR1AnN82qozDuJ_Y6oAVb82lBSb8Ghj0f5?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Annature**

(Best Australian option)

- Australian-based e-signature provider.
- Particularly worth considering for Australian businesses.
- Audit trails and document workflows.
- Australian data-hosting options.
- Worth investigating if local data residency matters.

Pricing is usage-based, with published starting prices around A\$1.75 per envelope.

[Annature website](https://annature.com.au/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional quotes and proposals.
- Send contracts for signing.
- Document templates and automation.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Useful if you regularly prepare client proposals.

Pricing starts around US\$19/user/month on annual billing.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF handling.
- Signatures, document editing and sharing.
- Useful if your business already uses Adobe Acrobat.
- Good for businesses with PDF-heavy workflows.

Pricing varies by Acrobat plan and business licensing.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign Australia](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business/e-signature.html)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best suited to | Main consideration |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Everyday contracts | Simple and straightforward |
| DocuSign | General business use | More advanced features |
| Annature | Australian businesses | Local data-hosting options |
| PandaDoc | Quotes and proposals | More than just signatures |
| Adobe Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Adobe ecosystem |


Prices and sending limits can vary by subscription, billing period and currency. DocuSign's Australian pricing is published in AUD; other prices above are indicative international starting prices. [ecom.docusign.com](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-AU/plans-and-pricing/esignature?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.starworks.com.au](https://www.starworks.com.au/best/software/e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/best-electronic-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before buying

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

- **Unlimited or generous signing requests\:** Avoid expensive per-document charges as your business grows.
- **Reusable templates\:** Save standard contracts so you don't have to prepare them repeatedly.
- **Automatic reminders\:** Chase customers who haven't signed.
- **Audit trails\:** Keep evidence of who signed and when.
- **Mobile signing\:** Let customers sign on their phones.
- **Cloud storage\:** Automatically retain signed copies.
- **Australian compliance\:** Check that the signing process meets the requirements for the particular documents you use.

Australia's electronic transactions laws generally recognise electronic signatures, but some document types have specific requirements. [www.starworks.com.au](https://www.starworks.com.au/best/software/e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.zendikt.com](https://www.zendikt.com/top-10-e-signature-software/australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to three\:

1. **Dropbox Sign** – if you want something inexpensive, easy to use and uncomplicated.
2. **DocuSign** – if you want a well-established platform with plenty of integrations and room to grow.
3. **Annature** – if Australian data hosting and a local provider are important.

## A question that would help me choose the right one

What type of small business are you running?

For example\:

- Trades or construction
- Consulting or professional services
- Real estate or property management
- Retail or general business
- Recruitment or HR
- Something else

And roughly how many documents would you send for signing each month?

With those two details, I can narrow it down to the best-value option rather than recommending software with features you don't need.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.

SignNow is selected as the best option for businesses because of its intuitive document workflows, collaboration tools, tracking, and unlimited users on paid plans, though additional fees may apply after 100 invitations annually. Adobe Acrobat Sign is recommended for general users, offering powerful signing, branding, bulk sending, tracking, and Microsoft Power Automate integration. PandaDoc is best for creating polished documents, while SignRequest and SignWell emphasize beginner-friendly simplicity. Adobe Fill & Sign is the leading free option for filling and signing PDFs. DocuSign stands out for reports, reminders, and audit trails, and Dropbox Sign is recommended for cloud-storage integration. Sign.Plus provides basic functionality, while Apple Preview is a convenient Mac-based personal tool. The guide advises choosing based on users, workflow complexity, customization, reporting, budget, integrations, and internet requirements. Products were tested for setup, signature methods, form creation, usability, pricing, performance, and collaboration features.
